prompt: Make these calls sequentially, never in parallel: inspect-listeners, exactly one play-arrangement-and-listen for Arrangement beats 0 through 4 with maximumDurationMs 8000 and only the bound listener ID, then get-pass once using the returned passId. This is explicit native v2 with the App-owned descriptive timing policy capped at 64 samples, not strict v1 or physical timing qualification. Constant 120 BPM is assumed; tempo automation is unsupported. The candidate remains ready=false with native_per_pass_validation_required: never promote it or use another listener. Existing production guarded positioning owns the nonzero start before arming; do not seek, stop, repair positioning, or retry. If any tool call fails, including argument validation or permission denial, report and end without correcting, retrying, or using a shell wait. If the pass failed or was cancelled, report the reason and end. If still nonterminal, report pending and end without polling; the harness waits for the real terminal job. Only if completed may you get typed context using its contextId and includeHistorical=true. Do not list passes or context. Queued acceptance is not completion. Leave transport running; do not record, launch Session clips, change the Set, install devices, or claim exclusive clip audio. Unknown attribution and freshness are valid historical track/range results.

setupContract.sourcePolicy: Explicit immutable hash-pinned native-v2 fixture with the listener at top-level device index 0. Stage only an owned copy; no installation, XML rewrite, external process adoption or v1 fallback.
setupContract.sequencePolicy: Run the exact reviewed prompt once and independently qualify capture, native proof and context. Only then the runner stops transport, verifies recording off, resolves one exact built-in Delay, loads it using browser.load_item, independently verifies exactly that added effect with the original listener unchanged, and moves that exact Delay to index 0 using devices.move. Verify original listener identity at index 1 and no other Set mutation, then wait at most 8000ms for authenticated registration renewal. The optional adjacent-insert adapter is not used. Run the same exact prompt once more with the newly discovered listener ID. Do not retry a failed capture or restart either process. Actor Browser/transport edits are not allowed.
setupContract.verificationPolicy: Both passes require separate App-owned queued expectations and independently accepted native proof. Re-read the actual listener reference/index, upstream Delay and listener source chain, unchanged post-edit Set, idle released capture, two distinct contexts and preservation of the original stored entry. The original historical context is never promoted to current.
setupContract.cleanupPolicy: The second capture leaves playback running. The copied fixture retains the single permitted Delay only until exact-PID runner shutdown and owned-fixture cleanup. Preserve failed attempts and account for partial insertion; never undo or modify a pre-existing user Set.
setupContract.reviewStatus: Reviewed deterministic two-capture edit-and-relisten scenario. Focused and owning-group real-Live execution plus ordinary-approval visible recovery passed on installed Live 11.3.43 on 2026-10-23; see playback-listening specification for retained failures and evidence limits. Subsequent merged-branch qualification covers all 19 non-native scenarios. Support targets Live 11, not a fixed patch; preserve actual version provenance after updates. Synthetic coverage is not actual native evidence.
